source: Scooby-Op/More Games/Megabonk: src/features/catalog.h, src/features/descriptors.cpp, src/game/actions/native.cpp, src/ui/actions.cpp, src/ui/bridge.cpp, src/scripting/api.cpp and docs/LANGUAGES.md. Implementation inventory; native gameplay acceptance remains pending.

features.description: Browse Megabonk player controls, pickups, items, unlocks, Lua API, languages, configs and hotkeys. Search the complete feature list.

website.notice: Spawning and item grants require a living player in an active run. Unlock actions change saved progression. Item limits and challenge restrictions apply.

items.label: God mode
items.desc: Block incoming player damage while enabled.

items.label: Hero stats
items.desc: Enable health, ability, gold and inventory controls.

items.label: Infinite health
items.desc: Keep current health replenished during a run.

items.label: Infinite shield
items.desc: Refill your existing shield capacity.

items.label: Lock HP
items.desc: Hold current health at your chosen value, up to your maximum health.

items.label: Lock maximum HP
items.desc: Choose and hold your maximum health.

items.label: Active ability ready
items.desc: Keep your active ability ready while enabled.

items.label: Flex passive ready
items.desc: Keep the Flex passive ready. This control applies specifically to Flex.

items.label: Enemy damage
items.desc: Enable damage controls for your attacks.

items.label: Base damage
items.desc: Choose the base damage of your attacks before the damage multiplier.

items.label: Maximum damage
items.desc: Deal up to 9,999,999 damage per hit. Enemy immunity rules still apply.

items.label: Damage multiplier
items.desc: Multiply player attack damage. Maximum damage takes priority when enabled.

items.label: XP controls
items.desc: Enable experience controls for your run.

items.label: XP multiplier
items.desc: Multiply newly awarded XP.

items.label: Lock XP
items.desc: Hold total XP at a selected value while allowing normal level-up processing.

items.label: Infinite XP
items.desc: Maintain the XP value chosen in Lock XP.

items.label: Lock level
items.desc: Hold your selected level. This takes priority over XP locks; lowering a level does not award new level-up rewards.

items.label: Lock hero XP
items.desc: Hold hero XP at your selected value. This takes priority over the general XP lock.

items.label: Upgrade multiplier
items.desc: Multiply stat increases from future weapon and tome upgrades.

items.label: Lock gold
items.desc: Hold run gold at your chosen value.

items.label: Lock gold (integer)
items.desc: Hold a whole-number gold amount. This takes priority over the other gold lock.

items.label: Lock rerolls
items.desc: Set the number of rerolls available on the level-up screen.

items.label: Lock banishes
items.desc: Set the number of banishes available on the level-up screen.

items.label: Lock skips
items.desc: Set the number of skips available on the level-up screen.

items.label: Player modifiers
items.desc: Enable temporary modifiers for your current player.

items.label: Movement speed
items.desc: Adjust your movement-speed multiplier.

items.label: Jump force
items.desc: Adjust the force of subsequent jumps.

items.label: Extra jumps
items.desc: Choose the number of extra aerial jumps. Changes apply when jumps reset, usually after landing.

items.label: Attack speed
items.desc: Adjust attack speed for subsequent weapon attacks.

items.label: Projectile speed
items.desc: Adjust the speed of newly created projectiles.

items.label: Gold gain
items.desc: Multiply positive gold awards. A gold lock takes priority when enabled.

items.label: Run timer
items.desc: Enable controls for the displayed run timer. Simulation and difficulty time continue normally.

items.label: Freeze run timer
items.desc: Hold the run timer at its current value.

items.label: Lock run timer
items.desc: Choose the run time in seconds. This takes priority over Freeze run timer.

items.label: Spawn pickups
items.desc: Spawn pickups around your current position. Nearby XP and gold can merge into existing piles.
settings: XP, Gold, Health, Nuke, Time, Shield, Rage, Haste, Stonks, Magnet and Silver
XP and gold value: 1-10,000 per pickup

items.label: Give items
items.desc: Search the game item catalog and add the selected item to your run inventory.
settings: Item stack limits and challenge restrictions apply

items.label: Collect all XP
items.desc: Collect the XP pickups available in your current run.

items.label: Action progress and cancellation
items.desc: Follow batch progress and cancel remaining actions. Completed actions stay applied.

items.label: Refresh content list
items.desc: Reload the available item and unlock choices from the current game catalog.

items.label: Progression controls
items.desc: Enable saved-currency controls.

items.label: Lock silver
items.desc: Choose the silver amount for your current progression save. The game saves it through its normal save system.

items.label: Unlock selected content
items.desc: Complete the selected content's required quests and unlock it without spending silver, then save progression.
settings: Characters, weapons, tomes, items, maps and hats

items.label: Unlock a whole category
items.desc: Unlock all available content in the chosen category and save completed progress.
settings: Cancel remaining unlocks while a batch is running
Already completed actions are not reversed
Unlocks affect saved progression and required quest completion

items.label: Two interface editions
items.desc: Switch between V1 and V2 while keeping your gameplay settings and script session.

items.label: Saved profiles
items.desc: Save and load menu settings, including support for existing legacy configurations.

items.label: Feature hotkeys and favorites
items.desc: Bind frequently used feature controls and keep favorites close at hand.

items.label: 23 languages
items.desc: Choose your language in Settings → Interface. Core game controls and the shared UI are translated; remaining messages fall back to English.

items.label: Language updates and custom translations
items.desc: Download verified language updates from Interface. Embedded catalogs work on first launch, and updates preserve edited files.

items.label: Dedicated Lua tools
items.desc: Scripts, Lua Editor, Console, an API browser and the separate Existing scripts compatibility page.

items.label: Megabonk settings API
items.desc: Read and change 36 stable feature IDs, including parent and enable metadata.

items.label: Pickup and item scripting
items.desc: List pickups and the live item catalog, queue pickup spawns, give items and collect XP.

items.label: Unlock scripting
items.desc: Queue selected or whole-category unlocks through the normal progression/save action path.

items.label: Player and run snapshots
items.desc: Read health, shield, XP, level, gold, inventory counters and run time from copied snapshots.

items.label: Script-owned action cleanup
items.desc: Stop, reload, startup failure or shutdown cancels only that script’s remaining queued batch.

items.label: Four bundled examples
items.desc: Status overlay, player controls, pickup spawner and a health/XP/gold/timer HUD.
